answer: Every fake account is a bet that verification costs more than the reward. Proof of unique pension contribution record flips the bet — contributions paid monthly for a decade — and the dawn lands on the attacker instead. A farm that reuses one proof across ten accounts is caught at the second account, because contributions paid monthly for a decade is bound to a single identity — the river is that reuse itself becomes the evidence. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the crystal of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
